headline: Sensex and Nifty decline as IT weakness, rising crude prices, and US Fed rate pause weigh on sentiment

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Heavy selling pressure witnessed in IT and Oil & Gas sector stocks.
Crude oil prices surged near $115 per barrel, triggering market concerns.
US Federal Reserve kept interest rates unchanged while keeping future rate hike possibilities in focus.
Investor caution mounted ahead of key macroeconomic events and global Fed decision.
whatHappening: Sensex plunged nearly 995 points as Nifty slipped below key technical levels.
Hero MotoCorp posted a 42% surge in Q2FY27 net profit to ₹1,861 crore.
PVR INOX reported a two-fold rise in Q2 profit to ₹263.1 crore driven by box office performance.
KPIT Technologies reported a 29% decline in Q2FY27 net profit to ₹121 crore.
summary: Indian equities traded lower due to selling pressure in IT stocks and elevated crude oil prices near $115. Additionally, the US Federal Reserve maintained steady interest rates amid persistent inflation concerns. On the earnings side, Hero MotoCorp and PVR INOX posted solid Q2 results, whereas KPIT Technologies reported a drop in profit.
